verdict.rationale: Aider documents a scripting-oriented API (CLI --message flag and a Python `Coder.create()/coder.run()` interface) that lets external code drive it programmatically, per aider-docs-6 and aider-docs-7. However, probes confirm there is no formal public API spec (llms.txt 404, no OpenAPI/swagger endpoints), so this is a lightweight scripting interface rather than a fully documented public API/SDK. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/REST or SDK reference docs, versioned API stability guarantees, independent third-party corroboration of the scripting API being used at scale.
